en.text:
Grants Passive Bonuses based on the element of your selected Super's element:
• <solar/>Solar: #e${50 + #d} Reload Speed
• <arc/>Arc: #e${50 + #d} Handling
• <void/>Void: #e${20 + #d} Stability
• <strand/>Strand: #e${20 + #d} Airborne Effectiveness
• <stasis/>Stasis: #e${20 + #d} Recoil Direction & 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

enhanced (
var d = 5
#e Stat Bonuses are increased by 5.
)
